title: Literal product selector coordinate distribution
statement: Let $\Omega$ be finite, let $\pi$ be a probability distribution on $\Omega$, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $\theta\in[-1,1]$. Independently draw two $n$-tuples from the product distribution generated by $\pi$, and draw an $n$-tuple of correlated sign pairs with parameter $\theta$. At each coordinate, use the first sign to select between the corresponding entries of the two sampled tuples, and use the second sign to make another such selection. The resulting $n$-tuple of pairs has the literal product selector coordinate distribution.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
